name: a subtask joins the bottom of its step's list, its words trimmed
a subtask on a step deleted elsewhere is kept with it
a subtask for a step the roadmap never held is gone
ticking a subtask writes done alone
a subtask change that changes nothing writes nothing
a subtask moved to the top of its step's list lands at the top
a subtask dropped below the one above it writes nothing
a subtask lands only below another of its step's subtasks
deleting a subtask writes its death
a link joins the bottom of its step's links
a link without an address is refused
renaming a link writes its title alone
deleting a link writes its death
a note is saved as text edited from the text the device holds
a step's first note is written from empty text
a note past 16,000 characters is refused
